review.name: Comfortable chair.
review.reviewBody: This is the chairiest chair I have ever owned.

review.name: Stylish and Comfortable
review.reviewBody: This chair is very comfortable for reading or watching TV, and it was easy to assemble. I love how it looks in my space!

review.name: Mid century
review.reviewBody: I am very pleased with the wood design and upholstery color of the cushions.

review.name: Armchair
review.reviewBody:
This is exactly what I wanted 
Comfortable and very attractive 
Not a cuddle up and read chair but very nice

review.name: Nate
review.reviewBody: I just tested the chair in the store. It’s pretty comfortable. But be aware: the dimensions shown in the image do not match the actual ones—the seat width is 21.5 inches, not 25.

review.name: False Advertising!!
review.reviewBody: The chair itself is comfortable and the teal is beautiful...BUT the wood shown in the photos do NOT match the product. The wood my chair came with is black, not walnut. I will be returning this chair asap

review.name: Perfect for music room
review.reviewBody: I purchased 2 of these for use in a music room. They replaced a Poang chair that was very comfortable, but the high back changed the listening acoustics. The EKENÄSET was a perfect solution and equally as comfortable as the Poang.

review.name: Classy Comfort
review.reviewBody: I dig this chair.  Solid construction - no creaks or flex.  It's very comfortable and has a super cool relaxed aesthetic going on.  Perfect place to sit while enjoying some Brubeck.  Looks great next to the potted rubber tree.

review.name: Poor Quality
review.reviewBody: I loved this chair in store, but it wasn’t as comfortable at home—maybe in a few months it will wear in a bit? My real issue with this chair is the manufacturing. The upholstery is poorly finished. It took 3 purchases to get a decent looking chair—poly stuffing sticking out on the bottom seam, misaligned holes for assembly, and lumpy cushions. I kept the third chair but had to use a lumbar pillow to cover the lumpy looking cushion.

review.name: Beautiful
review.reviewBody: Looks great, comfortable. Highly recommend

review.name: Very nice!
review.reviewBody: This is a very comfortable and very sturdy.  I have had this chair for about 8 months. I'm 6'2" and weigh 200 pounds and it works for me.  I use it to read and watch TV. I'm very happy with this product.

review.name: excellent kitchen seating
review.reviewBody: needed some lounge-y chairs for our kitchen and 2 of these fit the bill nicely. comfy but also sturdy

review.name: Very Comfy Chair
review.reviewBody: Surprisingly comfortable and sturdy.  Deep cushion that is soft, yet supportive.  Looks very high end.

review.name: Mid Century Modern Delight
review.reviewBody: The cushions are a tad firmer than I would prefer but a fantastic chair overall. It was easy to put together, sturdy with a solid wood construction, comfortable to sit in for long periods, and its appearance fits right in with MCM design. I was so pleased with it I got 2 of them

review.name: Love it!
review.reviewBody: It was super easy to assemble and I've the color. The color is calming and not busy. Sometimes IKEA furniture is tricky to assemble. This was so easy it took me ten minutes to assemble. I really love this chair and it is really comfortable. The price is a little much, otherwise it is awesome!

review.name: Nice chair just way overpriced for what you get
review.reviewBody: It’s comfy basic little chair

review.name: Ticks the boxes
review.reviewBody: Ekenaset arm chair ticks all the boxes . Not only is this chair good looking  it’s comfortable , overall support right where you need it . The fabric is seemingly durable. I vacuum furniture the texture hasn’t changed. Easy build , easy to use in any room , not too heavy or large to move .

review.name: Comfortable, classy looking
review.reviewBody: I would highly recommend these chairs. Great price, comfortable, and fit in a smaller room. They are also easy to assemble.

review.name: Stylish chairs
review.reviewBody: Good quality chairs. Reasonable price. Easy assembly.

review.name: Great chair
review.reviewBody: Well built elegant chair. Its fabric matches perfectly with a sofa available in the same fabric. Comfy to sit in.

This rug looks perfect in our living room of our new house. I love the new all in one piece!
It’s exactly what I was looking for. The color is perfect and it looks great in my dining room.
